column1: Fernando Tatis Jr. leads off in a strong hitter’s park and faces a hittable arm, making him a reliable pick with a steady track record and a recent uptick in hits. Yandy Diaz offers similar consistency at the top of the Rays’ lineup, especially with the platoon advantage at home. Jake McCarthy and Elly De La Cruz both bring solid recent form and favorable matchups if looking beyond the top two. Junior Caminero rounds out the group with dependable contact skills.
